properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Tls12SocketFactory pins the enabled TLS protocols to {"TLSv1.3", "TLSv1.2"} — despite the legacy class name, this both enables TLS 1.3 and sets the floor at TLS 1.2 (companion reading of the same line as ALG-a825c207). TLS 1.3 is permitted, which is the precondition for hybrid PQ key-exchange groups (X25519MLKEM768) on a capable platform (Android 16+/Conscrypt); whether the peer and platform negotiate it is not pinned by this code. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Same line as ALG-526dc733 read from the risk side: {"TLSv1.3", "TLSv1.2"} admits TLS 1.2, and any session that negotiates 1.2 uses classical-only key exchange (ECDHE) — harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure, and no hybrid PQ group can be negotiated on a 1.2 session. The 1.2 fallback exists for older platforms/proxies. Changeable here (raising the floor to 1.3 removes the classical-only fallback, at the cost of legacy-peer reachability).

properties.name: pqs:context
